heading: Confirm you received the parcel
intro: Tap confirm once you have received the parcel from the operator. You only need to do this once, no account required.

confirmed.title: Delivery confirmed successfully
confirmed.description: Thank you. The operator has received your confirmation and the parcel is now closed.

rejected.title: Refusal recorded
rejected.description: The operator will contact you to handle this parcel.
rejected.undoWindow: You have {{time}} left to undo if this was a mistake.
rejected.undoExpired: The undo window has closed. Please contact the operator if you need help.
rejected.undone: Refusal undone. You can confirm the delivery again.

reject.label: Please tell us why you are refusing
reject.placeholder: For example: parcel is dented, seal is broken, wrong item…
reject.required: Please enter a reason for refusing.

errors.title: Action could not be completed
errors.missingToken: This link is not valid. Please open the exact link from the operator's email.
errors.tokenInvalid: This link is not valid. Please open the exact link from the operator's email.
errors.tokenExpired: This link has expired. Please contact the operator to resend the confirmation email.
errors.tokenRevoked: This link is no longer active — you may have already confirmed, or the operator sent a newer email. If your confirmation already succeeded, nothing else is needed.
errors.notPendingConfirm: This parcel is no longer awaiting confirmation. Please contact the operator if you have not received it.
errors.undoWindowExpired: The undo window has already closed. Please contact the operator for help.
errors.validation: The submitted data is not valid. Please check the refusal reason (500 characters max).
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts on this link. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.requestPending: Your previous request is still being processed. Please wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.idempotency: A technical error occurred while sending the request. Please reopen the link from the email and try again.
errors.raceLost: The parcel status just changed. Please try again.
errors.upstream: The system is busy. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again or contact the operator.

privacy.title: A private link for your parcel
privacy.note: This link only lets you confirm your own parcel and needs no login. VietRide does not store the link on your device.

support: Need help? Contact the operator that sent you this email to get a new link.
